description: Find statutes and decisions on a topic or a question, in one call. Use it when you hold no citation yet. German keywords or a full question both work; decisions are matched by meaning. A decision hit carries `doknr` (pass it as `case` to the decision tools) and `cited_by`; a statute hit carries `slug` and `ref_norm` (pass them as `law` and `ref` to getNorm). Full text is held for Bayern, Brandenburg, Hessen, Nordrhein-Westfalen and Sachsen (see `getCoverage`). Hessen rows (`jurisdiction` 'HE'): pass `law_key` as `law` and `ref_norm` as `ref` to getNorm. Decisions can be filtered by `court`, `court_level`, `state`, `panel`, `from`/`to` and `decision_type`, and sorted with `sort` (relevance, weight: most cited first, newest); the answer counts them in `cases_total`. Example: {"q": "Eigenbedarf Kündigung Härtefall"}

court.description: One court, by its slug: bgh, bverwg, olg-koeln, ovg-sachsen.

include_repealed.description: Include repealed (aufgehobene) provisions. Off by default; turn it on when researching an older state of the law.

panel.description: A Senat of `court`: 'VIII. Zivilsenat', '2. Strafsenat' (BGH), '7. Senat' (BAG, BFH, BSG, BVerwG, BVerfG).

q.description: German query. Keywords, a citation, or a full question.
examples: Welche Rechte hat ein Arbeitnehmer bei verspäteter Lohnzahlung

scope.description: 'all' (default) searches both. Narrow only when you know which corpus answers.

state.description: A Land code (BY) or name slug (bayern), or bund / eu.

name: search
title: Search German law
